## Mossgrove 6: Daily Follow-ups
Every morning at 7:30 (Europe/London). Chases sent quotes after 3 and 7 days (the wording depends on whether the client opened it), expires quotes past their date, reminds clients about unpaid deposits and overdue invoices, and asks for a review two days after the final payment. Then the owner gets a summary: jobs starting this week, drafts to send, warm quotes worth a call, money coming in, and what was done for them.
